the_operator_steps: the local bundle carries no hardened runtime: the embedded Flutter framework carries another ad-hoc identity, and the library validation of the hardened runtime refuses it. The hardened runtime belongs to the distribution build, where Xcode signs every embedded framework with the identity of the developer
the signature of the local build is ad-hoc; the archive of the upload is signed with the *Apple Distribution* certificate of the operator
the development entitlement that Xcode injects into an ad-hoc build does not appear in a distribution build
